messages:
mara: opened PR to tighten the air-gapped installer steps and add a short KMS/HSM quick-check section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4399

diego: LGTM overall. tiny items: show SELinux note for socket paths, and prefer chgrp+chmod to chown.

sam: added a short socat example for a liveness probe: `socat -T5 -d -d STDIO OPEN:/var/run/pkcs11.sock` and a pkcs11-tool probe: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libykcs11.so -L` (mention vendor module path varies). warn to never paste keys.

mara: thanks, included both and changed chown -> chgrp redwood && chmod 750 /var/run/hsm. added SELinux line: if enforcing, set file context or consult security team.

diego: include offline bundle verification examples: `sha256sum redwood-offline-1.3.0.tar.gz` and `gpg --verify redwood-offline-1.3.0.tar.gz.sig redwood-offline-1.3.0.tar.gz` with link to public keyring.

qa-bot: QA note: hold on the nftables -> iptables migration snippet until QA reviews SNAT ordering. Marked TODO in PR.

docs-bot: linkcheck: one internal link failed (https://intranet.redwood/private/keyrotate)
